name: Columbia Edgewater (bottomland parkland on the Columbia Slough)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Columbia Edgewater Country Club, NE Portland, on the old Columbia River bottomland between Marine Drive and the slough (course chat, 2026-11-13). From the OSIP 2024 photo (fairway #7b967b, green #97ad7a, bunker #c0b594, water #53707a): the mown turf a cool sage green with a little teal in it, greens a lighter, yellower bent; bunker sand warm tan; the slough channels murky green-slate rather than blue. Trees: Douglas fir in deep blue-green, and the bottomland broadleaves of the slough (trees_columbia_edgewater.py): silvery black cottonwood, fresh Oregon ash and olive Oregon white oak (a drawing choice by variant; the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
